dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (JMA standard receipt software); compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux; uses ISAM indexed files with ASSIGN to symbolic names, COPY with REPLACING using // delimiters typical of GnuCOBOL/MicroFocus style
evidence: SELECT ... ASSIGN RECE01PARA ... ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED
no EXEC CICS, no EXEC SQL, no COMP-3

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) comment editing subsystem for the JMA ORCA standard medical billing software
purpose.summary: ORCR0040 is a large batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that handles comment editing (コメント編集) for medical insurance receipts. It reads and writes multiple indexed ISAM receipt data files (RECE02, RECE04, RECE05 and work variants), processes various medical billing categories including rehabilitation, home care, and special treatments, and automatically inserts or edits comment fields on receipts according to Japanese national health insurance rules. The program has an extensive revision history spanning 2002–2018 tracking numerous regulatory changes.

notable_features: 43 COPY statements with REPLACING using // delimiter syntax
1083 PERFORM statements indicating complex structured logic
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Multiple indexed ISAM files with DYNAMIC and SEQUENTIAL access
Japanese EUC/Shift-JIS encoded comments in source (latin-1 decoded)
Extensive revision history (2002–2018) with named maintainers
verdict.notes: Source comments are encoded in Japanese (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS, decoded as latin-1 producing mojibake in the snippet). The file is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA project. The // REPLACING delimiter and ASSIGN-to-symbolic-name style are characteristic of GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL. The truncated source shows only the first ~16000 chars of a 598KB file; classification is based on visible structure and known ORCA project context.
